requirements.statement: A user can sign in securely so their to-do list is private to them

criteria.must: A signed-out user is directed to sign in before seeing any to-do items
After signing in, the user sees only their own to-do items, never another user's

requirements.statement: A user can add a new to-do item

criteria.must: A signed-in user can create a new to-do item by providing a title
A newly created to-do item appears in the user's list

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of to-do items

criteria.must: A signed-in user can view a list of all their to-do items

requirements.statement: A user can mark a to-do item complete and reopen it

criteria.must: A user can mark an open to-do item as complete
A user can reopen a completed to-do item

requirements.statement: A user can edit a to-do item's title

criteria.must: A user can change the title of an existing to-do item and the change is saved

requirements.statement: A user can delete a to-do item

criteria.must: A user can delete a to-do item and it no longer appears in their list

requirements.statement: A user's to-do items persist in a database and remain available whenever they sign back in, from any device

criteria.must: A to-do item created in one session is still present after the user signs out and signs back in
A user's to-do items are available when they sign in from a different browser session
